guidelines.title: Suspected Lymphoma - Diagnostic Workup & Staging Pathway
guidelines.source: Clinical Guidelines - Lymphoma Workup Flowchart with Immunophenotyping & Validated Prognostic Indices
guidelines.description: Evidence-based clinical decision pathway guiding initial evaluation, peripheral blood flow cytometry vs. tissue biopsy triage, staging imaging (PET-CT vs CECT), bone marrow biopsy indications, CNS staging, pre-treatment viral prophylaxis (HBV, HCV, HIV), TLS metabolic prophylaxis, and validated prognostic scoring (aaIPI, IPI, FLIPI, MIPI, CLL-IPI, IPS, MALT-IPI, PIT).

findings.label: Peripheral smear / lymphocytosis
findings.help: Step 4 critical branch point: presence of abnormal circulating lymphocytes or absolute lymphocytosis (>5 x 10^9/L).

findings.label: Suspected / confirmed subtype
findings.help: Histopathological or flow-cytometric diagnosis per WHO / ICC classification.

findings.label: CLL therapy indication status
findings.help: Step 7 imaging triage for CLL: asymptomatic observation vs. progressive disease / cytopenias requiring therapy.

findings.label: Anatomical stage / clinical extent
findings.help: Validated anatomical extent (Ann Arbor stage) from clinical assessment or imaging.

values.label: MF extensive / nodular plaques / Sézary cells

findings.label: CNS high-risk features
findings.help: High-risk extranodal involvement (testicular, parameningeal, breast, renal, adrenal, >2 extranodal sites with high LDH, blastoid MCL).

values.label: Standard risk / no high-risk CNS features

findings.label: Planned regimen & organ safety
findings.help: Planned systemic therapy requiring baseline organ assessment (anthracycline cardiotoxicity or high-dose MTX renal monitoring).

values.label: High-dose Methotrexate planned (age >40 or renal risk)
Other standard therapy / low cardiac risk

findings.label: Hepatitis B serology (HBsAg / HBcAb)
findings.help: Screening before B-cell depleting (anti-CD20) or immunosuppressive therapy to prevent fatal HBV reactivation.

findings.label: Hepatitis C serology (Anti-HCV)
findings.help: Screening before systemic therapy. If positive, quantitative HCV RNA is required with hepatologist referral.

findings.label: HIV screening serology
findings.help: Step 3 viral marker: if positive, check CD4 count, viral load, initiate OI prophylaxis, and coordinate non-myelosuppressive ART.

findings.label: Tumor lysis syndrome (TLS) metabolic risk
findings.help: Metabolic panel screening (Ca, Phos, Uric acid, LDH) to detect hyperuricemia and high TLS risk before therapy.

values.label: High TLS risk (bulky disease, elevated uric acid / LDH)

findings.label: Double-hit (DHL) FISH panel (MYC/BCL2)
findings.help: Reflex cytogenetic testing in GCB-DLBCL to screen for MYC and BCL-2 rearrangements.

findings.label: Age group (IPI / aaIPI / FLIPI / MIPI stratification)
findings.help: Age factor for prognostic scoring: Age <= 60 uses aaIPI (max score 3); Age > 60 uses standard IPI/FLIPI; Age >= 70 confers adverse risk in MIPI and MALT-IPI.

findings.label: ECOG performance status
findings.help: Performance status at presentation (ECOG >= 2 is an adverse prognostic factor in IPI, aaIPI, MIPI, and PIT).

findings.label: Serum LDH (Lactate Dehydrogenase)
findings.help: Serum LDH compared to upper limit of normal (ULN). Elevated LDH indicates high tumor proliferation and is an adverse factor across all indices.

findings.label: Extranodal involvement sites
findings.help: Number of involved extranodal anatomical sites (> 1 extranodal site is an adverse factor in standard IPI).

findings.label: Hemoglobin level
findings.help: Adverse anemia threshold: Hb < 12 g/dL in FLIPI; Hb < 10.5 g/dL in IPS for Hodgkin Lymphoma.

findings.label: White blood cell count (WBC)
findings.help: Elevated leucocyte count: WBC >= 10 x 10^9/L in MIPI; WBC >= 15 x 10^9/L in IPS.

findings.label: Serum albumin
findings.help: Serum albumin < 4.0 g/dL is an adverse factor in IPS for Hodgkin Lymphoma.

findings.label: Beta-2 microglobulin (B2M)
findings.help: Elevated B2M (> 3.5 mg/L in CLL-IPI; > ULN in FLIPI-2) indicates high tumor burden.

findings.label: TP53 mutation / 17p deletion
findings.help: TP53 disruption (17p deletion or mutation) confers 4 points in CLL-IPI and predicts chemotherapy refractoriness.

values.label: TP53 mutated or 17p deletion present (high risk)

findings.label: IGHV somatic mutation status
findings.help: Unmutated IGHV (>=98% homology to germline) confers 2 points in CLL-IPI.

findings.label: Bone marrow biopsy involvement
findings.help: Bone marrow infiltration confirmed on aspirate/trephine (adverse factor in FLIPI-2 and PIT).

findings.label: Number of involved nodal sites
findings.help: > 4 nodal anatomical areas involved confers 1 adverse point in FLIPI.

functions.name: aaIPI
functions.label: Age-adjusted IPI (aaIPI)
functions.description: Age-adjusted International Prognostic Index for DLBCL in patients age <= 60 years. Sums Stage III-IV (1 pt), elevated LDH (1 pt), and ECOG >= 2 (1 pt). Max score: 3.

functions.name: IPI
functions.label: International Prognostic Index (IPI)
functions.description: Standard IPI for DLBCL (all ages). Sums Age > 60 (1 pt), Stage III-IV (1 pt), elevated LDH (1 pt), ECOG >= 2 (1 pt), Extranodal > 1 site (1 pt). Max: 5.

functions.name: FLIPI
functions.label: Follicular Lymphoma International Prognostic Index (FLIPI)
functions.description: Prognostic index for Follicular Lymphoma. Sums Age > 60 (1 pt), Stage III-IV (1 pt), Hb < 12 g/dL (1 pt), Nodal sites > 4 (1 pt), LDH > ULN (1 pt). Max: 5.

functions.name: CLLIPI
functions.label: CLL International Prognostic Index (CLL-IPI)
functions.description: Prognostic scoring for CLL: TP53 del/mut (4 pts), IGHV unmutated (2 pts), B2M > 3.5 mg/L (2 pts), Stage III-IV (1 pt), Age > 65 (1 pt). Max: 10.

functions.name: MIPI
functions.label: MCL International Prognostic Index (MIPI)
functions.description: Simplified MIPI for Mantle Cell Lymphoma. Evaluates Age, ECOG, LDH, and WBC count. Max: 11.

functions.name: IPS
functions.label: International Prognostic Score (IPS)
functions.description: IPS for Hodgkin Lymphoma: Albumin < 4 (1 pt), Hb < 10.5 (1 pt), Stage IV (1 pt), Age >= 45 (1 pt), WBC >= 15 (1 pt). Max: 5.

functions.name: MALT_IPI
functions.label: MALT-IPI
functions.description: Marginal Zone / MALT International Prognostic Index. Sums Age >= 70 (1 pt), Stage III-IV (1 pt), LDH > ULN (1 pt). Max: 3.

functions.name: PIT
functions.label: Prognostic Index for PTCL (PIT)
functions.description: Prognostic scoring for Peripheral T-Cell Lymphoma. Age > 60 (1 pt), ECOG >= 2 (1 pt), LDH > ULN (1 pt), Bone marrow involvement (1 pt). Max: 4.

outcomes.label: Needs clinician review (Safety gate)
outcomes.rationale: Critical diagnostic or staging inputs are missing, unrecorded, or derived from unverified free-text. A clinician must review before ordering invasive biopsies or treatment.

outcomes.label: HBV Reactivation Prophylaxis Protocol
outcomes.rationale: HBsAg or HBcAb-IgG positivity carries a high risk of lethal Hepatitis B reactivation under anti-CD20 (rituximab) or immunosuppressive chemotherapy. Quantitative HBV DNA and prophylactic entecavir or tenofovir are mandatory.

regimens.name: Quantitative HBV DNA PCR test
Initiate prophylactic antiviral therapy (Entecavir 0.5 mg daily or Tenofovir)
Continue antiviral prophylaxis during and for at least 12 months post-chemotherapy
LFT monitoring every 4-6 weeks

outcomes.label: HCV Management: Quantitative HCV RNA + Hepatology Referral
outcomes.rationale: Step 3: Anti-HCV positive patients require quantitative HCV RNA testing. If detectable, urgent referral to a gastroenterologist/hepatologist prior to systemic chemo is mandatory to coordinate direct-acting antiviral (DAA) therapy.

regimens.name: Quantitative HCV RNA by RT-PCR
Gastroenterology / Hepatology referral before systemic therapy
Coordinate Direct-Acting Antiviral (DAA) therapy

outcomes.label: HIV Lymphoma Protocol: CD4/Viral Load + ART Coordination
outcomes.rationale: Step 3: In HIV-positive patients, evaluate CD4 count and HIV viral load, initiate opportunistic infection (OI) prophylaxis per CD4 count, and coordinate ART avoiding myelosuppressive drugs (e.g. avoid Zidovudine).

regimens.name: CD4 cell count and HIV-1 RNA viral load
Opportunistic infection (OI) assessment and prophylaxis (PJP, MAC, Fungal)
Coordinate with HIV specialist; avoid myelosuppressive antiretroviral agents

outcomes.label: Tumor Lysis Syndrome (TLS) Metabolic Prophylaxis
outcomes.rationale: Step 3: Metabolic screening identifies high-risk TLS (elevated uric acid, high LDH, bulky disease). Mandatory vigorous IV hydration, urine output monitoring, and Rasburicase or Allopurinol prophylaxis.

regimens.name: Aggressive intravenous hydration (2.5-3 L/m2/day) with strict I/O monitoring
Rasburicase (0.2 mg/kg IV) for hyperuricemia or Allopurinol for moderate risk
Serum electrolytes, Ca, Phos, Uric acid, Creatinine, LDH Q6-12h

outcomes.label: Double-Hit Lymphoma (DHL): High-Grade B-Cell Protocol
outcomes.rationale: Step 8: GCB-DLBCL harboring concurrent MYC and BCL-2 rearrangements has poor outcomes with standard R-CHOP. Dose-adjusted EPOCH-R (DA-EPOCH-R) and CNS prophylaxis are recommended.

regimens.name: Dose-adjusted EPOCH-R (DA-EPOCH-R) regimen
Diagnostic LP and CNS-directed prophylaxis (IT methotrexate / cytarabine)
Evaluate for autologous or allogeneic stem cell transplantation in CR1

outcomes.label: Peripheral Blood Flow Cytometry (Avoid initial nodal biopsy)
outcomes.rationale: Step 4 & 5: Abnormal lymphocytosis on smear enables rapid peripheral blood immunophenotyping. Lymph node biopsy is avoided (unless FL or Richter transformation suspected). Bone marrow exam is NOT required if flow confirms diagnosis.

regimens.name: Flow cytometry CLPD panel (CD5, CD10, CD19, CD20, CD23, CD22, FMC7, CD200, Cyclin D1)
Subtype differentiation (CLL vs MCL vs FL vs SMZL vs HCL vs T/NK-CLPD)
Omit initial lymph node biopsy and routine bone marrow examination

outcomes.label: Tissue Excision Biopsy + Immunohistochemistry (IHC)
outcomes.rationale: Step 6: In the absence of peripheral lymphocytosis, primary diagnosis requires histopathological examination. Excision biopsy of the largest accessible lymph node is preferred over core needle.

regimens.name: Excision biopsy of largest accessible lymph node (preferred over FNA/core)
Comprehensive lymphoma IHC panel (B-cell, T-cell, proliferation markers)
Image-guided core needle biopsy (USG/CT) if nodes are deep/internal or surgery contraindicated

outcomes.label: Staging: Whole-body PET-CT + Bone Marrow Examination
outcomes.rationale: Step 7 & 8: For low-grade lymphomas (FL, MZL, MCL, Burkitt, PTCL), whole-body 18F-FDG PET-CT is standard staging, AND bone marrow aspiration + trephine biopsy is mandatory because marrow involvement dictates stage and prognosis.

regimens.name: Whole-body 18F-FDG PET-CT (skull base to mid-thigh)
Bone marrow aspiration + imprint + trephine biopsy
Flow cytometry and cytogenetics on bone marrow aspirate

outcomes.label: Staging: PET-CT alone (Bone Marrow NOT required)
outcomes.rationale: Step 8: In Stage I-II DLBCL and Classical Hodgkin Lymphoma staged with high-quality PET-CT, PET-CT has exceptional negative predictive value for marrow disease. Routine bone marrow biopsy can be safely omitted.

regimens.name: Whole-body 18F-FDG PET-CT
Omit routine bone marrow biopsy (PET-CT sufficient)
Calculate disease-specific prognostic index (aaIPI / IPI / IPS)

outcomes.label: CLL Staging: CXR PA view + Abdominal USG (Minimal Staging)
outcomes.rationale: Step 7: For asymptomatic CLL without therapy indication, avoid unnecessary radiation from CT and invasive bone marrow biopsy. Baseline CXR and abdominal ultrasonography are sufficient.

regimens.name: CXR PA view + Ultrasound abdomen and pelvis
Omit CT chest/abdomen/pelvis and omit bone marrow biopsy
Active clinical and haematological surveillance (every 3-6 months)

outcomes.label: CLL Pre-Therapy Workup: CECT + Bone Marrow + FISH Panel
outcomes.rationale: Step 7 & 8: When CLL requires systemic treatment: CECT chest/abdomen/pelvis is indicated, bone marrow biopsy evaluates cytopenias, and CLL FISH panel (17p deletion, TP53, IgVH mutation status) is mandatory.

regimens.name: CECT chest + abdomen + pelvis
Bone marrow aspirate & trephine biopsy (for cytopenias / reserve assessment)
CLL FISH panel (del 17p, 11q, 13q, +12) + TP53 mutation + IgVH status
Calculate CLL-IPI prognostic score

outcomes.label: MZL Staging: Diagnostic CECT + SPEP + Subtype Genetics
outcomes.rationale: Step 7 & 8: In Marginal Zone Lymphoma (all subtypes), CECT chest/abdomen/pelvis is preferred. Serum Protein Electrophoresis (SPEP) evaluates paraproteinemia, and t(11;18) FISH in gastric MALT predicts anti-H. pylori resistance.

regimens.name: CECT chest + abdomen + pelvis
Serum Protein Electrophoresis (SPEP) for paraprotein / immunoglobulin spike
Bone marrow aspirate and trephine biopsy
t(11;18) translocation FISH if gastric MALT (predicts H. pylori resistance)

outcomes.label: High-Risk CNS Staging (LP with CSF flow) + 2D-ECHO
outcomes.rationale: Step 8: For DLBCL with high-risk extranodal involvement (testicular, parameningeal, renal/adrenal) or blastoid MCL: diagnostic lumbar puncture with CSF morphology and flow cytometry is mandatory. 2D-ECHO is required prior to anthracyclines.

regimens.name: Diagnostic Lumbar Puncture: CSF cytology + flow cytometry
Brain MRI with contrast (if neurological symptoms or PCNSL suspected)
2D-Echocardiography (LVEF assessment) prior to anthracycline therapy
Plan CNS-directed prophylaxis (intrathecal MTX or systemic high-dose MTX)

outcomes.label: Cutaneous T-Cell Lymphoma: Skin Biopsy + Stage-Directed Imaging
outcomes.rationale: Step 6 & 7: Skin biopsy is mandatory for MF/Sézary subtype confirmation. Early thin-plaque disease requires clinical staging only. Extensive skin, tumour, or Sézary cells in peripheral blood require CECT chest/abdomen/pelvis.

regimens.name: Skin biopsy (punch or incisional, mandatory for histopathology + TCR clonality)
Clinical skin staging (mSWAT score for early plaque disease)
CECT chest + abdomen + pelvis if nodular, extensive skin disease, or Sézary cells
Peripheral blood smear review for cerebriform Sézary cells

outcomes.label: High-Dose MTX Protocol: Mandatory DTPA-GFR Clearance
outcomes.rationale: Step 8: High-dose Methotrexate requires accurate baseline renal glomerular clearance. In patients aged > 40 or with diabetic/hypertensive/borderline eGFR, 99mTc-DTPA GFR is mandatory before infusion.

regimens.name: 99mTc-DTPA GFR clearance test (mandatory before high-dose MTX if age > 40)
Hydration and urine alkalinization protocol (target urinary pH >= 7.0)
Leucovorin rescue planning and methotrexate serum drug level monitoring

rules.label: Missing or unparsed smear/presentation
Missing or unparsed lymphoma subtype
Hepatitis B positive requiring antiviral prophylaxis
Hepatitis C positive requiring HCV RNA and hepatology referral
HIV positive requiring viral load, CD4 count, and OI prophylaxis
High metabolic risk requiring Tumor Lysis Syndrome prophylaxis
Circulating lymphocytosis present on smear
Solid mass without lymphocytosis (biopsy needed)
Double-Hit Lymphoma confirmed (DA-EPOCH-R protocol)
Asymptomatic CLL without treatment indication
CLL with treatment indicated
Marginal Zone Lymphoma (MALT / SMZL)
Cutaneous T-Cell Lymphoma (MF / Sézary)
DLBCL or MCL with CNS high-risk anatomical features
High-dose Methotrexate planned requiring DTPA-GFR renal clearance
Limited-stage DLBCL or Hodgkin Lymphoma on PET-CT (omit marrow)
Low-grade lymphomas, MCL, Burkitt, PTCL (PET-CT + BM required)
Advanced DLBCL (Age <= 60) with high aaIPI score (>= 2)
Advanced DLBCL standard risk (PET-CT staging)

guidelines.title: Follicular Lymphoma - first-line treatment pathway
guidelines.source: Follicular Lymphoma Treatment Workflow; Lymphoma Workup Flowchart
guidelines.description: Assigns an adult follicular lymphoma patient to a treatment group based on histology, Ann Arbor stage, GELF tumour burden, bone marrow status and fitness.

findings.label: Histology / grade
findings.help: WHO histological grade from the pathology report.

findings.label: Ann Arbor stage
findings.help: Validated anatomical stage (PET-CT / CECT).

findings.label: Stage II contiguity
findings.help: Only relevant for Stage II.

findings.label: Bone marrow biopsy
findings.help: Marrow involvement upstages the patient to Stage IV.

findings.label: GELF tumour burden
findings.help: High if any GELF criterion is met (bulky mass > 7 cm, 3 nodes > 3 cm, cytopenias, B symptoms...).

findings.label: Fitness for systemic therapy
findings.help: Fit for full-dose chemoimmunotherapy (BR / R-CHOP).

outcomes.label: Needs clinician review
outcomes.rationale: Required data is missing or unreliable. A clinician must decide - no regimen is suggested.

outcomes.label: Treat as DLBCL
outcomes.rationale: Grade 3b / transformed FL behaves as aggressive lymphoma.

regimens.name: R-CHOP x 6 cycles (+/- ISRT to bulky sites)
Polatuzumab vedotin + R-CHP

outcomes.label: Duodenal FL - watch / local therapy
outcomes.rationale: Primary duodenal FL is usually indolent and localised.

regimens.name: Observation / watchful waiting
ISRT 24-30 Gy if symptomatic

outcomes.label: Stage I - curative radiotherapy
outcomes.rationale: Limited stage with cleared marrow: curative-intent radiotherapy.

regimens.name: ISRT 24 Gy in 12 fractions
Watchful waiting if radiotherapy contraindicated

outcomes.label: Stage II contiguous - radiotherapy
outcomes.rationale: Contiguous nodal disease fits a single radiation field.

regimens.name: IFRT / ISRT 24 Gy
Single-agent rituximab 375 mg/m2 weekly x 4

outcomes.label: Advanced, low burden - watch and wait
outcomes.rationale: Asymptomatic low tumour burden: no survival benefit from early treatment.

regimens.name: Watchful waiting (review every 3-6 months)
Single-agent rituximab x 4 if patient declines observation

outcomes.label: Advanced, high burden - systemic therapy
outcomes.rationale: High GELF burden in a fit patient.

regimens.name: Bendamustine + rituximab (BR) x 6
R-CHOP x 6
Rituximab + lenalidomide (R2)

outcomes.label: Advanced, high burden - frail
outcomes.rationale: High burden but not fit for full-dose therapy.

regimens.name: Single-agent rituximab weekly x 4
Attenuated bendamustine + rituximab
R-CVP

rules.label: Histology unknown
Grade 3b or transformed
Duodenal FL
Stage unknown
Stage I, marrow not assessed
Stage I, marrow cleared
Stage I but marrow involved (restage as IV)
Stage II contiguous
Advanced disease, GELF unknown
Advanced disease, low burden
Advanced, high burden, fit
Advanced, high burden, frail

guidelines.title: DLBCL & PMBCL - First-Line Treatment Pathway
guidelines.source: Clinical Guidelines - Lymphoma Treatment Workflow (DLBCL & PMBCL)
guidelines.description: Evidence-based clinical decision pathway guiding first-line treatment for Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL) and Primary Mediastinal B-Cell Lymphoma (PMBCL). Incorporates anthracycline fitness assessment (LVEF/Echo, age, comorbidities), stage-based stratification (Limited Stage I-II: aaIPI 0 non-bulky PET-adapted R-CHOP vs aaIPI >= 1 / bulky R-CHOP x 6 + IFRT; Advanced Stage III-IV: standard R-CHOP x 6 vs Pola-R-CHP for non-GCB IPI >= 2), mandatory CNS prophylaxis for high-risk sites, HIV-associated DLBCL (CD4 >= 50 vs < 50), regimens for unfit/frail patients (R-miniCHOP, R-CEOP, R-GCVP, BR/R-PEP-C), PMBCL pathway (DA-EPOCH-R with CBC dose adjustment vs R-CHOP), pre-phase therapy, G-CSF prophylaxis, and cardiac monitoring.

findings.label: Histological lymphoma diagnosis
findings.help: Confirmed WHO histological diagnosis on formal surgical excisional or core biopsy.

findings.label: Anthracycline (R-CHOP) fitness status
findings.help: Cardiopulmonary fitness and comorbidity evaluation: normal LVEF >= 50%, age < 70, absence of severe uncontrolled organ failure.

values.label: Fit for standard R-CHOP (LVEF >= 50%, Age < 70, controlled comorbidities)
Cardiac dysfunction / CAD / RWMA / prior anthracycline toxicity (LVEF < 50%)
Elderly with significant frailty / comorbid (Age > 70 with frailty)
Severe hepatic / renal / systemic contraindication to anthracyclines
Frail / advanced decline (candidate for palliative / low-intensity therapy only)

findings.label: Ann Arbor anatomical disease stage
findings.help: Anatomical stage classification validated by baseline whole-body 18F-FDG PET-CT.

findings.label: Bulky disease status (>= 7.5 cm)
findings.help: Single largest contiguous tumor mass dimension on PET-CT (cutoff >= 7.5 cm per clinical guideline).

findings.label: DLBCL cell-of-origin (IHC Hans algorithm)
findings.help: Immunohistochemical subtyping (CD10, BCL6, MUM1): Germinal Center B-cell (GCB) vs Non-GCB / Activated B-cell (ABC).

findings.label: CNS high-risk anatomical involvement
findings.help: High-risk anatomical sites: testicular, breast, adnexa, adrenal, renal involvement, or confirmed Double-Hit Lymphoma (DHL).

values.label: High CNS risk (testicular, breast, adnexal, renal, adrenal DLBCL or DHL)
Standard CNS risk (no high-risk anatomical involvement)

findings.label: HIV screening serology
findings.help: Step 4 HIV status: HIV-positive patients require concurrent ART, OI prophylaxis, and CD4-adapted chemoimmunotherapy.

values.label: HIV confirmed positive (requires CD4 count & ART coordination)

findings.label: CD4 lymphocyte count (in HIV+ DLBCL)
findings.help: Absolute CD4 count threshold: CD4 >= 50 cells/uL permits Rituximab (SC-RR-EPOCH); CD4 < 50 cells/uL contraindicates Rituximab (EPOCH without R).

findings.label: Central venous access availability (for PMBCL)
findings.help: Continuous infusional chemotherapy (DA-EPOCH-R) mandates central venous access (PICC line or chemo port).

values.label: Central venous access available (PICC line or chemo port in place)
No central venous access / peripheral IV only

findings.label: 2D-ECHO LVEF monitoring on therapy
findings.help: Mandatory 2D-ECHO at baseline and after cycle 4 of R-CHOP. Decline > 10% requires anthracycline discontinuation.

findings.label: Pre-phase therapy indication
findings.help: Mandatory pre-phase Cyclophosphamide + Steroids in: elderly Stage III/IV, bulky disease, GI involvement, or poor PS.

values.label: Pre-phase indicated (elderly III/IV, bulky, GI involvement, poor PS)
No pre-phase indicated (standard good PS non-bulky)

findings.label: Patient age bracket (IPI cutoff)
findings.help: Prognostic age cutoff: age <= 60 years uses aaIPI (3 factors); age > 60 years uses standard 5-factor IPI.

findings.label: Serum LDH (Lactate Dehydrogenase)
findings.help: Pre-treatment serum LDH compared to institutional upper limit of normal (ULN).

findings.label: ECOG performance status
findings.help: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group functional status score.

values.label: ECOG 0-1 (ambulatory, fully active or restricted light work)
ECOG >= 2 (capable of limited self-care, bed/chair > 50% waking hours)

findings.label: Extranodal involvement sites
findings.help: Number of documented extranodal disease sites (excluding bone marrow / spleen).

functions.name: aaIPI
functions.label: Age-adjusted IPI (aaIPI)
functions.description: Age-adjusted International Prognostic Index for DLBCL in patients age <= 60 years. Sums Stage III-IV (1 pt), elevated LDH (1 pt), and ECOG >= 2 (1 pt). Max: 3.

functions.name: IPI
functions.label: International Prognostic Index (IPI)
functions.description: Full 5-factor prognostic index for DLBCL across all age groups: Age > 60 (1 pt), Stage III-IV (1 pt), elevated LDH (1 pt), ECOG >= 2 (1 pt), Extranodal > 1 site (1 pt). Max: 5.

outcomes.label: Needs clinician review (Safety Gate / Missing Data)
outcomes.rationale: Required clinical findings (subtype, stage, cardiac fitness, or viral status) are missing or incomplete. A clinician must review before initiating treatment.

outcomes.label: Cardiac Toxicity Alert: Discontinue Anthracycline
outcomes.rationale: Step 9: 2D-ECHO showed LVEF decline > 10% from baseline. Discontinue doxorubicin/anthracyclines immediately, refer to cardiology, and switch to non-cardiotoxic alternative (etoposide or gemcitabine).

regimens.name: Urgent Cardiology referral & cardioprotective optimization
Discontinue Doxorubicin -> Switch to R-CEOP (Etoposide replaces Doxorubicin)
Alternative: R-GCVP / R-CGOP (Gemcitabine based)

outcomes.label: High-Risk CNS DLBCL: Intrathecal + High-Dose MTX Prophylaxis
outcomes.rationale: Step 3: DLBCL involving testicular, breast, adnexal, adrenal, renal sites or confirmed Double-Hit Lymphoma (DHL) has high CNS recurrence risk (> 10%). Intrathecal MTX with each R-CHOP cycle plus 2 cycles of High-Dose Methotrexate (HD-MTX 3-3.5 g/m2) post cycle 6 are mandatory (provided DTPA GFR > 60 mL/min and PET-CT shows CMR).

regimens.name: R-CHOP x 6 cycles q21d
Intrathecal Methotrexate (12 mg) with each chemotherapy cycle
High-Dose Methotrexate (3.0-3.5 g/m2) x 2 cycles after cycle 6 (DTPA GFR > 60 required)
Consider prophylactic radiation to both testes if testicular involvement

outcomes.label: HIV+ DLBCL (CD4 >= 50): SC-RR-EPOCH + ART + OI Prophylaxis
outcomes.rationale: Step 4: In HIV-positive DLBCL with CD4 >= 50 cells/uL, Rituximab can be safely administered. SC-RR-EPOCH with concurrent ART and opportunistic infection prophylaxis is recommended. PET-CT after cycle 2 guides subsequent cycles.

regimens.name: SC-RR-EPOCH (short-course dose-dense infusional EPOCH with Rituximab)
Optimized combination Antiretroviral Therapy (ART) continuation
Opportunistic infection prophylaxis (TMP-SMX for PCP + fungal prophylaxis)
Interim PET-CT after cycle 2 (if CMR -> 1 more cycle, total 3; if not CMR -> 3rd cycle)

outcomes.label: HIV+ DLBCL (CD4 < 50): EPOCH (Without Rituximab) + ART
outcomes.rationale: Step 4: Severe CD4 lymphopenia (< 50 cells/uL) carries prohibitive risk of fatal infectious toxicity if Rituximab is given. Rituximab is avoided; treatment is infusional EPOCH alone with ART optimization and strict OI prophylaxis.

regimens.name: Infusional EPOCH without Rituximab (Rituximab avoided due to CD4 < 50)
Aggressive ART optimization & viral load monitoring
Mandatory multi-pathogen opportunistic infection prophylaxis
Re-assess CD4 count after ART response before subsequent therapy decisions

outcomes.label: Limited Stage DLBCL (aaIPI 0, Non-Bulky): PET-Adapted R-CHOP x 3-4 Cycles
outcomes.rationale: Step 2: Limited Stage (Stage I-II) with aaIPI 0 and non-bulky disease (< 7.5 cm) in a fit patient: R-CHOP x 3 cycles followed by interim PET-CT. If interim PET shows Complete Metabolic Response (CMR) -> 1 additional cycle (total 4 R-CHOP); if PET is positive -> 3 more cycles (total 6) OR 30-35 Gy IFRT. (Alternative if PET unavailable: 4 x R-CHOP + 2 x Rituximab).

regimens.name: R-CHOP x 3 cycles (Rituximab, Cyclophosphamide, Doxorubicin, Vincristine, Prednisone)
Interim 18F-FDG PET-CT after cycle 3
If PET CMR: +1 more R-CHOP cycle (total 4 cycles, no radiation)
If PET positive: 3 more R-CHOP cycles OR 30-35 Gy IFRT

outcomes.label: Limited Stage DLBCL (aaIPI >= 1 or Bulky >= 7.5 cm): R-CHOP x 6 + IFRT
outcomes.rationale: Step 2: Limited stage DLBCL with aaIPI >= 1 or bulky disease (>= 7.5 cm): full 6 cycles of R-CHOP plus Involved-Field Radiotherapy (IFRT 30-35 Gy) to bulky disease site(s).

regimens.name: R-CHOP x 6 cycles q21d
Involved-Field Radiotherapy (IFRT) 30-35 Gy to initial bulky disease site(s)
Mandatory 2D-ECHO after cycle 4 to monitor LVEF

outcomes.label: Advanced Non-GCB DLBCL (IPI >= 2, Age < 70, Non-Bulky): Pola-R-CHP x 6
outcomes.rationale: Step 2: POLARIX regimen for previously untreated Non-GCB DLBCL with IPI >= 2, age < 70 years, and non-bulky disease. Polatuzumab vedotin (1.8 mg/kg) replaces vincristine in the R-CHP backbone, demonstrating superior progression-free survival.

regimens.name: Polatuzumab vedotin (1.8 mg/kg) + R-CHP x 6 cycles q21d
Rituximab monotherapy (375 mg/m2) x 2 additional doses
Pegylated G-CSF primary prophylaxis 24h post-chemotherapy
End-of-treatment (EOT) 18F-FDG PET-CT assessment

outcomes.label: Advanced Stage DLBCL (Fit): Standard R-CHOP x 6 Cycles
outcomes.rationale: Step 2: Standard backbone for advanced stage (Stage III-IV) fit DLBCL is R-CHOP x 6 cycles. End-of-treatment PET-CT: if CMR -> observation (no consolidative RT, except testicular DLBCL); if Partial Response (PR) with uptake at a single residual site -> consolidative RT 30-35 Gy.

regimens.name: R-CHOP x 6 cycles q21d
2D-ECHO mandatory after cycle 4 to screen for cardiotoxicity
End-of-treatment (EOT) PET-CT assessment
Consolidative RT 30-35 Gy if PR with uptake at single residual site

outcomes.label: Unfit (Cardiac Dysfunction): R-CEOP x 6 Cycles
outcomes.rationale: Step 5: For patients with significant cardiac dysfunction (LVEF < 50%, CAD with RWMA, or prior congestive heart failure), Doxorubicin is contraindicated. R-CEOP (Etoposide 50 mg/m2 IV D1-3 replacing Doxorubicin) achieves curative intent without cardiotoxicity.

regimens.name: R-CEOP x 6 cycles (Rituximab, Cyclophosphamide, Etoposide, Vincristine, Prednisone)
Prophylactic G-CSF support
End-of-treatment PET-CT response evaluation

outcomes.label: Unfit / Elderly Frail (Curative Intent): R-miniCHOP x 6 Cycles
outcomes.rationale: Step 5: For elderly patients (age > 70 with frailty) who remain eligible for curative intent: R-miniCHOP (attenuated doses of cyclophosphamide 400 mg/m2, doxorubicin 25 mg/m2, vincristine 1 mg cap, and prednisone with full-dose rituximab) significantly reduces treatment-related mortality while preserving curative potential.

regimens.name: R-miniCHOP x 6 cycles q21d (attenuated doses + full-dose Rituximab 375 mg/m2)
Pre-phase Cyclophosphamide + Prednisone x 7 days prior to cycle 1
Mandatory Pegylated G-CSF support in all cycles

outcomes.label: Unfit (Anthracycline Ineligible): R-GCVP / R-CGOP x 6 Cycles
outcomes.rationale: Step 5: Gemcitabine-based chemoimmunotherapy (R-GCVP: Gemcitabine, Cyclophosphamide, Vincristine, Prednisolone, or R-CGOP: Gemcitabine + Oxaliplatin) provides an active non-anthracycline curative option.

regimens.name: R-GCVP x 6 cycles (Rituximab, Gemcitabine, Cyclophosphamide, Vincristine, Prednisone)
G-CSF prophylaxis

outcomes.label: Frail / Palliative Intent: BR or R-PEP-C / Palliative RT
outcomes.rationale: Step 5: For frail patients unable to tolerate systemic curative regimens: palliative-intent BR (Bendamustine + Rituximab), oral metronomic R-PEP-C, or involved-field RT alone (for Stage I-II with limited field) provides disease control and symptom relief with minimal toxicity.

regimens.name: Bendamustine + Rituximab (BR) attenuated / palliative intent
Oral metronomic R-PEP-C (Prednisone, Etoposide, Procarbazine, Cyclophosphamide + Rituximab)
Radiotherapy alone if Stage I-II disease coverable in limited radiation field

outcomes.label: PMBCL (Fit, Central Access Available): DA-EPOCH-R x 6 Cycles
outcomes.rationale: PMBCL Step 2: In confirmed Primary Mediastinal B-Cell Lymphoma in fit patients with central venous access (PICC/port): Dose-Adjusted EPOCH-R (DA-EPOCH-R) x 6 cycles is the preferred regimen. CBC on Days 8, 10, 12 guides pharmacodynamic dose escalation. Interim PET-CT at cycle 4; if DS <= 3 -> complete 6 cycles without consolidative RT.

regimens.name: DA-EPOCH-R x 6 cycles (continuous 96-hr infusional etoposide, doxorubicin, vincristine + bolus cyclophosphamide & rituximab)
CBC on Days 8, 10, and 12 of each cycle to calculate pharmacodynamic dose adjustment
Mandatory prophylactic G-CSF in every cycle
Interim PET-CT at cycle 4 and End-of-Treatment PET-CT at cycle 6

outcomes.label: PMBCL (No Central Access / Infrastructure): R-CHOP x 6 Cycles + RT
outcomes.rationale: PMBCL Step 2: When infusional DA-EPOCH-R cannot be delivered (e.g. lack of central line access or ambulatory infusion pumps): R-CHOP x 6 cycles is the standard alternative. Interim PET-CT at cycle 4: if positive (DS 4-5) -> consolidative radiotherapy after cycle 6.

regimens.name: R-CHOP x 6 cycles q21d
Interim PET-CT at cycle 4
Consolidative RT to mediastinum if interim PET positive (DS 4-5)

rules.label: Lymphoma subtype or stage unknown
DLBCL stage or fitness unknown
Anthracycline fitness unknown
Cardiotoxicity gate: LVEF decline > 10% on therapy
PMBCL with central venous access: DA-EPOCH-R
PMBCL without central venous access: R-CHOP alternative
HIV+ DLBCL with CD4 >= 50: SC-RR-EPOCH with Rituximab
HIV+ DLBCL with CD4 < 50: EPOCH without Rituximab
Cardiac dysfunction: R-CEOP non-anthracycline regimen
Elderly with frailty (curative intent): R-miniCHOP
Anthracycline ineligible: R-GCVP gemcitabine regimen
Frail / Palliative intent: BR or R-PEP-C
High CNS relapse risk sites: IT + HD-MTX prophylaxis
Limited stage aaIPI 0, non-bulky: PET-adapted R-CHOP x 3-4
Limited stage with bulky disease (>= 7.5 cm): R-CHOP x 6 + IFRT
Limited stage with aaIPI >= 1: R-CHOP x 6 + IFRT
Advanced Non-GCB DLBCL (IPI >= 2, Age < 70, non-bulky): Pola-R-CHP
Advanced stage DLBCL fit: Standard R-CHOP x 6

guidelines.title: Relapsed / Refractory DLBCL - Salvage, CAR-T & Palliative Pathways
guidelines.source: Clinical Guidelines - Relapsed / Refractory DLBCL Treatment Workflow Flowchart
guidelines.description: Evidence-based clinical decision pathway guiding evaluation and management of Relapsed or Refractory Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL). Enforces mandatory repeat biopsy and PET-CT staging, stratifies by relapse timing (late relapse > 12 months vs early relapse <= 12 months / primary refractory), guides Pathway A (salvage chemo R-GEMOX/R-GDP/Pola-R-GEMOX x 3, post-salvage PET response, and ASCT consolidation), Pathway B (CAR-T evaluation, bridging with R-GEMOX/Pola-R-GEMOX, anti-CD19 CAR-T Axi-cel/Tisa-cel/Liso-cel vs Glofitamab-GEMOX), Pathway C (unfit for chemotherapy: palliative care, oral metronomic, targeted lenalidomide/bortezomib for non-GCB), consolidative/palliative radiotherapy (30-36 Gy), and enforces the critical contraindication avoiding bendamustine/Pola-BR when CAR-T is a future possibility.

findings.label: Relapse tissue biopsy confirmation status
findings.help: Mandatory repeat biopsy from most representative site (largest size + highest SUVmax) to confirm DLBCL, repeat IHC (GCB vs non-GCB), and exclude indolent transformation.

values.label: Transformed from prior indolent lymphoma (e.g. transformed FL)
Biopsy pending / FNAC only (repeat core/excisional biopsy mandatory)

findings.label: Timing of relapse / progression relative to R-CHOP
findings.help: Critical branch point: Relapse > 12 months after R-CHOP completion (chemosensitive likely -> Pathway A) vs Relapse <= 12 months / progression ON R-CHOP (early/refractory -> Pathway B).

values.label: Late relapse (> 12 months post completion of first-line R-CHOP)
Early relapse (<= 12 months post completion of first-line R-CHOP)
Primary refractory / progression ON first-line R-CHOP therapy

findings.label: Fitness for combination systemic chemotherapy
findings.help: General fitness to tolerate intensive or non-transplant combination chemotherapy vs candidate for palliative/low-intensity oral therapy only.

values.label: Chemotherapy eligible (candidate for intensive or standard combination salvage)
Unfit for combination chemotherapy (candidate for palliative / oral metronomic / targeted only)

findings.label: Fitness for salvage chemotherapy + ASCT
findings.help: Eligibility for high-dose chemotherapy and Autologous Stem Cell Transplant (age, ECOG PS, absence of severe organ dysfunction).

values.label: Fit for intensive salvage therapy + Autologous Stem Cell Transplant (ASCT)

findings.label: Fitness for anti-CD19 CAR-T cell therapy
findings.help: Physiological fitness to tolerate cytokine release syndrome (CRS) and neurotoxicity (ICANS) associated with CAR-T.

values.label: Fit for CAR-T cell therapy (tolerable CRS/ICANS risk, adequate organ reserve)
Not fit for CAR-T cell therapy

findings.label: PET-CT response after salvage chemotherapy (3 cycles)
findings.help: Deauville 5-point scale score after 3 cycles of salvage chemo (R-GEMOX / R-GDP / Pola-R-GEMOX).

values.label: Chemosensitive: PR or CR (Deauville Score 1-3, >= 50% reduction in uptake)
Partial response / residual uptake (Deauville Score 4, no new disease sites)
Not yet assessed / salvage therapy not yet completed

findings.label: CAR-T cell therapy future intention / possibility
findings.help: CRITICAL SAFETY GATE: Bendamustine causes prolonged T-cell lymphopenia and impairs CAR-T manufacture. Must be AVOIDED if CAR-T remains a possibility.

values.label: CAR-T is planned or remains a future possibility (MANDATORY TO AVOID BENDA / POLA-BR)
CAR-T is definitively NOT planned / patient ineligible / unavailable

findings.label: Repeat IHC cell-of-origin subtype at relapse
findings.help: Tumor biology may evolve at relapse. Non-GCB subtype qualifies for oral targeted lenalidomide or bortezomib in the palliative setting.

values.label: Non-GCB phenotype (eligible for targeted lenalidomide / bortezomib)

findings.label: Residual or bulky disease site for radiation
findings.help: Presence of single residual PET-positive site or bulky site at presentation suitable for consolidative radiotherapy (30-36 Gy).

values.label: Single residual PET+ site OR initial bulky site (candidate for consolidative RT 30-36 Gy)
Diffuse widespread multi-site disease (systemic therapy only)

outcomes.label: Needs clinician review (Safety Gate / Missing Workup)
outcomes.rationale: Required clinical findings (relapse timing, fitness status, or biopsy confirmation) are missing or incomplete. A multidisciplinary tumor board review is required.

outcomes.label: Relapse Workup Gate: Mandatory Repeat Biopsy & Staging PET-CT
outcomes.rationale: Step 1: Repeat biopsy is MANDATORY from the most representative site (largest size + highest SUVmax on PET-CT) to rule out transformation from indolent lymphoma, confirm DLBCL histology, and re-evaluate IHC (GCB vs non-GCB) as tumor biology evolves at relapse. Salvage therapy must not begin without tissue confirmation.

regimens.name: Whole-body 18F-FDG PET-CT to identify highest SUVmax biopsy site
Image-guided core needle or surgical excisional biopsy of dominant lesion
Repeat immunohistochemistry panel (CD20, CD10, BCL6, MUM1, MYC, BCL2)
Baseline 2D-ECHO (LVEF) & Viral screening (HBsAg, HBcAb, HCV, HIV)

outcomes.label: Pathway A (Relapse > 12 Mo, Fit for ASCT): Salvage Chemotherapy x 3 Cycles
outcomes.rationale: Step 4A: Late relapse (> 12 months) in a transplant-eligible patient. Initiate platinum/gemcitabine salvage chemoimmunotherapy for 3 cycles (R-GEMOX, R-GDP, or Pola-R-GEMOX), followed by mandatory PET-CT restaging.

regimens.name: R-GEMOX x 3 cycles (Rituximab 375 mg/m2 D1, Gemcitabine 1000 mg/m2 D1,8, Oxaliplatin 100 mg/m2 D1 q14d)
Alternative: R-GDP x 3 cycles (Rituximab, Gemcitabine, Dexamethasone, Cisplatin/Carboplatin)
Alternative: Pola-R-GEMOX x 3 cycles (Polatuzumab vedotin + R-GEMOX)
Mandatory 18F-FDG PET-CT response evaluation after cycle 3

outcomes.label: Pathway A: Chemosensitive Responders -> Autologous Stem Cell Transplant (ASCT)
outcomes.rationale: Step 4A: Patients achieving PR or CR (Deauville Score 1-3) after 3 cycles of salvage chemotherapy demonstrate chemosensitivity and proceed directly to high-dose therapy and Autologous Stem Cell Transplant (ASCT) — the optimal curative-intent consolidation. Consolidative RT (30-36 Gy) may be delivered to initial bulky sites or single residual sites post-ASCT.

regimens.name: Peripheral blood stem cell (PBSC) mobilization (G-CSF +/- Plerixafor) and apheresis harvest
High-dose conditioning chemotherapy (BEAM regimen: Carmustine, Etoposide, Cytarabine, Melphalan)
Autologous stem cell transplantation and post-transplant supportive care
Consolidative ISRT 30-36 Gy to single residual or initial presentation bulky site post-ASCT

outcomes.label: Pathway A (Salvage DS-4 Partial Response): Re-Biopsy & MDT CAR-T Triage
outcomes.rationale: Step 4A: Deauville Score 4 after 3 cycles of salvage chemo represents residual metabolic uptake without progression. A repeat biopsy is considered to distinguish viable lymphoma from post-treatment inflammatory necrosis. If viable disease persists, re-assess for CAR-T cell therapy in a Multidisciplinary Tumor Board (MDT).

regimens.name: Targeted biopsy of residual FDG-avid mass to verify viable lymphoma vs inflammatory necrosis
Multidisciplinary Tumor Board review for CAR-T eligibility vs consolidative RT

outcomes.label: Pathway A (Salvage Refractory DS-5): Switch to CAR-T Cell Therapy
outcomes.rationale: Step 4A: Deauville Score 5 (progression or no response after salvage chemotherapy) indicates chemotherapy-refractory disease. Chemotherapy-refractory patients have poor outcomes with ASCT and should immediately transition to anti-CD19 CAR-T cell therapy if fit and eligible.

regimens.name: Urgent referral to CAR-T certified cellular therapy center
Anti-CD19 CAR-T cell infusion (Axi-cel, Tisa-cel, or Liso-cel)
Non-bendamustine bridging therapy (R-GEMOX or localized RT)

outcomes.label: Pathway A (Relapse > 12 Mo, NOT Fit for ASCT): Non-Transplant Salvage x 6 Cycles
outcomes.rationale: Step 4A (Alt): Late relapse (> 12 months) in patients ineligible for high-dose chemotherapy/ASCT. Goal is disease control with tolerable therapy. Administer 3 cycles of R-GEMOX, R-GDP, or Pola-R-GEMOX; if responding, complete 6 cycles total. Glofitamab-GEMOX is an alternative bispecific option. (Avoid bendamustine/Pola-BR if CAR-T remains a future possibility).

regimens.name: R-GEMOX / R-GDP / Pola-R-GEMOX x 3 cycles -> if responding complete 6 cycles total
Alternative: Glofitamab-GEM-OX (CD20xCD3 bispecific + GemOx)
Note: Carboplatin replaces cisplatin in R-GDP for renal impairment
Consolidative RT (30-36 Gy) to single residual or bulky presentation site post-chemotherapy

outcomes.label: Pathway B (Early Relapse / Refractory, Fit for CAR-T): Primary CAR-T Therapy
outcomes.rationale: Step 4B: Early relapse (<= 12 months) or primary refractory DLBCL carries chemotherapy resistance. Anti-CD19 CAR-T cell therapy is the PRIMARY curative-intent strategy. Bridging/debulking while awaiting manufacture should use R-GEMOX, Pola-R-GEMOX, or dominant-site radiation. STRICT SAFETY WARNING: AVOID Pola-BR and Bendamustine, as bendamustine causes profound prolonged T-cell depletion and severely impairs CAR-T manufacture.

regimens.name: T-cell leukapheresis for anti-CD19 CAR-T manufacturing (Axi-cel / Tisa-cel / Liso-cel)
Bridging therapy: R-GEMOX or Pola-R-GEMOX or dominant-site RT (STRICTLY AVOID BENDAMUSTINE)
Pre-infusion lymphodepleting chemotherapy: Fludarabine (30 mg/m2 D1-3) + Cyclophosphamide (300 mg/m2 D1-3)
Anti-CD19 CAR-T cell infusion with mandatory inpatient CRS and ICANS neurotoxicity monitoring

outcomes.label: Pathway B (Early Relapse / Refractory, NOT Fit for CAR-T): Glofitamab-GEMOX
outcomes.rationale: Step 4B (Alt): Early relapse or primary refractory DLBCL in patients ineligible for CAR-T cell therapy. Glofitamab-GEMOX (CD20xCD3 bispecific T-cell engager with gemcitabine and oxaliplatin) delivers high response rates without requiring apheresis or autologous T-cell fitness. Obinutuzumab pre-treatment and step-up dosing are mandatory to mitigate CRS.

regimens.name: Obinutuzumab pre-treatment (1000 mg IV on D-7 of Cycle 1) to deplete circulating B cells and mitigate CRS
Glofitamab step-up dosing (2.5 mg D8, 10 mg D15 of Cycle 1, then 30 mg D1 Cycle 2 onwards)
Gemcitabine (1000 mg/m2) + Oxaliplatin (100 mg/m2) chemotherapy backbone
Alternative if Glofitamab unavailable: R-GEMOX / R-GDP x 6 cycles

outcomes.label: Pathway B (NOT Fit for CAR-T, CAR-T Excluded): Pola-BR x 6 Cycles
outcomes.rationale: Step 4B (Alt): Pola-BR (Polatuzumab vedotin + Bendamustine + Rituximab) x 6 cycles is indicated ONLY when CAR-T cell therapy is definitively NOT planned or permanently contraindicated. Bendamustine impairs T-cell collection, but provides valuable disease control in non-transplant/non-CAR-T patients.

regimens.name: Polatuzumab vedotin (1.8 mg/kg D1) + Bendamustine (90 mg/m2 D1,2) + Rituximab (375 mg/m2 D1) x 6 cycles q28d
Prophylactic G-CSF support in every cycle
End-of-treatment PET-CT assessment

outcomes.label: Pathway C (Unfit for Chemo, Non-GCB): Palliative Care + Targeted Lenalidomide / Bortezomib
outcomes.rationale: Step 5 / Pathway C: Frail patients unable to tolerate IV combination chemotherapy with confirmed Non-GCB DLBCL phenotype. Non-GCB tumors exhibit NF-kB pathway activation and respond to oral immunomodulatory or proteasome inhibitor targeted therapy (Lenalidomide or Bortezomib based) with low toxicity.

regimens.name: Oral Lenalidomide (20-25 mg daily D1-21 q28d +/- Rituximab)
Alternative: Subcutaneous Bortezomib-based therapy
Palliative symptom care, pain management, and transfusion support
Palliative radiotherapy to localized painful or symptomatic sites

outcomes.label: Pathway C (Unfit for Chemo): Palliative Care + Oral Metronomic Chemotherapy
outcomes.rationale: Step 5 / Pathway C: Frail patients unable to tolerate IV chemotherapy. Comprehensive palliative care, symptom management, and low-toxicity oral metronomic chemotherapy (e.g. oral etoposide-based regimens) provide disease stabilization without compromising quality of life.

regimens.name: Best supportive care: pain control, nutritional support, palliative care team co-management
Oral metronomic chemotherapy (e.g. low-dose oral etoposide 50 mg/m2 or oral cyclophosphamide)
Palliative RT for localized bleeding, bone pain, or mass obstruction

outcomes.label: Consolidative Radiotherapy (30-36 Gy) to Residual or Bulky Site
outcomes.rationale: Special Decision Rule: Radiation therapy (30-36 Gy) plays a vital consolidative role in R/R DLBCL when given to a single residual PET-positive site after salvage chemotherapy or to an initial presentation bulky site post-ASCT.

regimens.name: Consolidative ISRT 30-36 Gy delivered to single residual FDG-avid lesion or initial presentation bulk
Post-radiotherapy PET-CT assessment at 12 weeks

rules.label: Biopsy pending: Mandatory repeat biopsy before salvage
Relapse timing or overall fitness unknown
Overall chemotherapy fitness unknown
Unfit for chemo, Non-GCB: Targeted Lenalidomide / Bortezomib
Unfit for chemo: Palliative care + Oral metronomic chemotherapy
Early relapse / refractory, Fit for CAR-T: Primary CAR-T Therapy
Early relapse / refractory, NOT Fit for CAR-T (CAR-T definitively excluded): Pola-BR
Early relapse / refractory, NOT Fit for CAR-T: Glofitamab-GEMOX
Late relapse, post-salvage chemosensitive (PR or better, DS 1-3): ASCT
Late relapse, post-salvage DS-4 partial uptake: Biopsy & CAR-T triage
Late relapse, salvage refractory (DS-5): Re-assess for CAR-T
Late relapse, Fit for ASCT: Salvage Chemotherapy x 3 Cycles
Single residual site post-salvage: Consolidative Radiotherapy (30-36 Gy)
Late relapse, NOT Fit for ASCT: Non-Transplant Salvage x 6 Cycles
